True to that scripture, renowned journalist and compere, Ezra Ukanwa, has taken a beautiful new step in his life as he tied the knot with his heartthrob, Nissi Chiemerie, in a colourful wedding ceremony that brought family, friends and well-wishers together.
The wedding, which took place on Saturday, November 14, 2026, was nothing short of beautiful, as the media personality exchanged marital vows with his bride at the Deeper Life Bible Church, Anambra 1 Headquarters, Umunya, Anambra State.
Looking dapper in an elegant white wedding suit, the groom stole the show with his charming appearance, while his gorgeous bride looked every inch the princess in her stunning white wedding gown.
The celebration continued at Abbey Hall, All Saints Cathedral, along Episcopal Drive by Awina Road, Onitsha, where guests joined the newlyweds to celebrate their union.
Ezra Ukanwa uses his pen and voice to inform, educate,and entertain audiences across Abuja and beyond.
As congratulatory messages continue to pour in, one thing is certain: the man who has spent years writing impactful stories and making other people’s special occasions memorable, now has his own beautiful love story to celebrate.
